clue.text: Economical inclusion of key in opening part of an Italian composition

indicators.note: inclusion of the key means that note is set inside the other piece

parts.words: opening part of an Italian composition
parts.note: Spring is the first concerto of Vivaldi's The Four Seasons
A is a musical key

explanation.surface: A music critic praises the thrifty way a key is introduced at the start of an Italian work.
explanation.walkthrough: The Italian composition is Vivaldi's The Four Seasons, whose opening concerto is Spring; the key A goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sparing with something means using it frugally, the habit of an economical person.

clue.text: Native from one quarter runs to here when thrown out

indicators.note: thrown out suggests the letters are tossed about and land in a new order

explanation.surface: A local runs off to some place after being expelled.
explanation.definitionFit: A southerner is a person born in the south, one of the four compass quarters.

clue.text: eg sole four-letter word, in itself, is harmless

indicators.note: a four-letter word sitting in the following words, which hide it

parts.note: the letters run from the end of itself across is into harmless

explanation.surface: A bad four-letter word is quite inoffensive in itself, at least when it names a flatfish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Four-letter word' suggests a swear word; here it tells you the answer has four letters, and 'in' says it is concealed in the words that follow.
explanation.definitionFit: The sole is a flatfish, so it is an example of the category named by the answer.

clue.text: Become aware of crew reportedly being summoned

indicators.note: reportedly tells us we want words that sound like the ones the clue gives

parts.note: to scent something is to become aware of it; a four is a rowing crew of four oarsmen

explanation.surface: Sailors find out they have been called in.
explanation.walkthrough: SCENT (become aware of) and FOUR (a rowing crew of four oarsmen) are said aloud to give the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: If someone is sent for, a message has gone out calling them to come.

clue.text: Not just 25% of invested capital held by one rich country

parts.note: a quarter of the eight letters of invested is its opening two

indicators.note: held by means the capital sits inside the letters around it

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
the US is a wealthy country
Quito is the capital of Ecuador

explanation.surface: A finance piece about part of a fund being kept by one wealthy nation.
explanation.walkthrough: IN is the first 25% of INVESTED; QUITO, Ecuador's capital, is then held by I (one) and US.
explanation.definitionFit: Something iniquitous is wicked and grossly unfair, the reverse of what is just.

clue.text: Quartet unchanged by upsetting spell

indicators.note: upsetting the spelling, reading it backwards, leaves the word just as it was

parts.note: the Swedish pop group had four members

explanation.surface: A group of four is unaffected by a disturbing spell.
explanation.walkthrough: The group's name reads the same in both directions, so turning its spelling round changes nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Swedish band famous for Waterloo was a foursome whose palindromic name reverses to itself.

clue.text: One of four players, not a good one, in football club

parts.note: in bridge the four players are named North, South, East and West
a ham is a bad actor, a poor player

explanation.surface: A footballer, one of a group of four, is not much good at his club.
explanation.walkthrough: The four players are at the bridge table; the poor player is an actor, so 'players' switches meaning mid-clue.
explanation.definitionFit: West Ham United is a London football club in the Premier League.

clue.text: Like ten to four on some watches

definitions.text: Like ten to four on some watches

parts.words: Like ten to four on some watches
parts.note: on a dial the numbers ten and four sit directly across from each other

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a time, 3:50, but it is about where the figures 10 and 4 sit on a clock face.
explanation.definitionFit: Ten and four face each other across the centre of a dial, so they are positioned facing one another.

clue.text: Outlaw returned four-poster, say, under arrest

indicators.note: returned means the word for outlaw is read back to front

parts.note: to outlaw something is to ban it
a four-poster is an example of a bed

explanation.surface: A fugitive came back to a four-poster and was arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: Nabbed is slang for caught or seized by police, so the person is in custody.

clue.text: Time put into needlework producing not a lot of note?

indicators.note: put into means the letter for time is placed inside the craft word

parts.note: crochet is a kind of needlework done with a hook

explanation.surface: Time spent on sewing produces nothing remarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not a lot of note' sounds like 'unremarkable'; read musically it is a short note, a quarter of a semibreve.
explanation.definitionFit: A crotchet is a quarter note in music, only a fraction of a whole note's length.

clue.text: Volume finished with old size of paper

indicators.note: finished with means the next letter comes at the end of the word

parts.note: a quart is a measure of liquid volume

explanation.surface: A book was completed using an outdated paper size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' looks like the definition (a quarto is also a book) but it is the measure QUART.
explanation.definitionFit: Quarto is a paper format made by folding a sheet twice into four leaves.

clue.text: Contrive, in April, reorganised event featuring Irish quarters

indicators.note: reorganised says these letters are set out again in a different order

explanation.surface: An organiser plans an April event involving four parts of Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: Ireland is divided into four provinces, Leinster, Munster, Connacht and Ulster, here called quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: An interprovincial contest is held between teams from Ireland's four provinces, as in rugby.

clue.text: Making easier page without fourth line I penned in old language inside

indicators.note: inside means the rest is held within the shortened word
without fourth means the word loses its fourth letter

parts.note: the word whose fourth letter is removed

indicators.note: penned in means the letter is enclosed by the language

parts.note: Latin is a classical language no longer spoken

explanation.surface: A page stripped of a line is being simplified, with I writing in an ancient tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' here means outside, not lacking: the shortened page wraps round everything that follows, while 'penned in' puts I within the old language.
explanation.definitionFit: Palliating means relieving or mitigating pain or trouble, so making it easier to bear.

clue.text: Four-wheeler put away, held by agent still? Not so

parts.note: a car has four wheels

indicators.note: held by means the eating word sits inside the agent's name

parts.note: James Bond is the famous secret agent
to put away food is to eat it

explanation.surface: A car was stowed by a spy who is still there, or perhaps not.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' looks like an adverb meaning 'yet', but it describes a drink with no bubbles.
explanation.definitionFit: A carbonated drink is fizzy, the opposite of a still one, as with mineral water.

clue.text: Reversal of plain boundaries not proceeding in upright way

indicators.note: Reversal of means the word for plain is written backwards

parts.note: a llano is a grassy plain in South America
in cricket a boundary that hits the ground first scores four, so it is called a four

explanation.surface: Flat land with borders that turned round, and something not moving upright.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a ball reaching the boundary after bouncing scores four runs, a 'four'.
explanation.definitionFit: Going on hands and knees means crawling rather than walking upright.

clue.text: See 15
Reasons with number of Romans in specs, so to speak

indicators.note: in means the Roman number goes inside the word for specks

parts.note: specs sounds like specks, and motes are specks of dust
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Reasons for counting Romans while wearing glasses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Specs' looks like glasses, but 'so to speak' asks you to hear it as 'specks', tiny particles of dust; the Roman number is four.
explanation.definitionFit: Motives are the reasons that drive someone's actions.

clue.text: Husband wearing suit in domestic circles

indicators.note: wearing means the letter is clothed by the suit around it

parts.note: hearts is one of the four card suits
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogies

explanation.surface: A husband in a suit is at home among his family.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'suit' is a card suit, not clothing, though 'wearing' plays on the clothing sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The hearth stands for home and family life, so hearths are household settings.

clue.text: Part of format the writer used for book

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of the layout the author chose for a book.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'used for book' as the definition, but 'used for' is only the link joining the wordplay to 'book'; the answer itself names a book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Matthew is the first Gospel, a book of the New Testament.

clue.text: Inside normal UFO, possibly, covering space and time

indicators.note: possibly hints that these letters might form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Something within an ordinary flying saucer might span space and time.
explanation.definitionFit: Spacetime has three spatial dimensions plus one of time, giving four in all.

clue.text: In very small piece, it's certainly not square

indicators.note: In means the second word is placed inside the first

parts.note: a whit is the tiniest amount

explanation.surface: A tiny item is anything but old-fashioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Square' means conventional or unfashionable, not a shape.
explanation.definitionFit: With-it is slang for fashionable and up to date, the opposite of stuffy.

clue.text: Needle that's four inches in length

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a pointer on a dial, as on a clock
second meaning: the unit used to measure a horse's height

explanation.walkthrough: Both senses look like sewing or ruler talk; one is a clock pointer, the other a horse-measuring unit.
explanation.definitionFit: A clock pointer is called this, and the same word is a four-inch unit for horse heights.

clue.text: Male quadruped breaks barricades

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
parts means separates or breaks apart

explanation.surface: A male animal smashes through barriers.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramparts are defensive walls or embankments, protective barriers around a fort.

clue.text: Observe 19's follower

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to notice or take heed of
second meaning: the Gospel that comes after Matthew

explanation.walkthrough: 19 down is MATTHEW, and the next Gospel in the New Testament comes after it.
explanation.definitionFit: To mark something is to notice it; Mark is also the second Gospel of the Bible.

clue.text: Sign name over two others, one of four famous ones

indicators.note: over means placed so as to cover the following letters, holding them inside

parts.note: Leo is a sign of the zodiac
two more of the same letter just given for name

explanation.surface: A signature placed above two more, one of a celebrated foursome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two others' means two more of the letter just used for name, and 'over' is used in its covering sense, the sign and name enclosing them.
explanation.definitionFit: John Lennon was one of the Beatles, the most famous four-piece band.

clue.text: Four up, ominously, as the end approaches?

definitions.text: Four up, ominously, as the end approaches?

parts.words: Four up, ominously, as the end approaches?
parts.note: the four riders of the Apocalypse, mounted and heralding the end of the world

explanation.walkthrough: 'Four up' sounds like a score in a game nearing its end; 'up' means on horseback and the end is the Apocalypse.
explanation.definitionFit: Revelation describes four riders on horses, symbolising conquest, war, famine and death.
